The '''6G2 DeepSpace explorer droid''' was a 1.3-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] a model from [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. They were assigned to [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessels]] for the purpose of investigating new [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. Each was equipped with a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor unit]] with a three-meter flight ceiling, a retractable heavy grasper arm, a [[Holorecorder/Legends|holographic/audio recorder]], a long-range [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]], and an atmospheric sensor which could determine a planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] class within half an hour. A 6G2 cost 6,700 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new.
